subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceLastRun` plus non-running `killed` reconciliation as canonical behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with announce handoffs always tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it changes persisted session recovery semantics and an internal tool boundary that automation should not silently approve.

options.title: Accept After Status Is Clean
options.body: Rerun or repair `check-lint`, resolve the dirty merge state, and land this PR as the canonical announce recovery/tool-isolation fix.

options.title: Change The Terminal State
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired stored state for aborted delivery-only announce runs, request that state adjustment before merge.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery Design
options.body: If announce-specific state is not the desired model, pause this PR and design a shared inter-session delivery recovery contract first.
